description:
NOTE:  Read all paperwork carefully for compliance and pay special attention to the NAICS Code being used. The NAICS Code must be listed in your SAM profile.  

This is a combined synopsis solicitation for a 1-1/2 Inch ID Hose Assemblies.

1.  Make sure there is a Point of Contact Name, Email, and Phone Number on your submittal.

2.  RETURN all paperwork requested (RFQ & any attached forms).

REQUIRED:  Return the following

- RFQ Completely Filled-out & Returned

- Corporate Experience Data Sheet

- Vendor Information Sheet

See the attached RFQ and other documents for details of the requirement and submittal instructions.
